# macOS Companion MCP Server

> Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for native macOS system control, clipboard management, desktop notifications, audio devices, and workspace automation.

## Installation
- NPX: `npx -y @surendranb/macos-companion-mcp`
- UVX: `uvx macos-companion-mcp`
- Curl: `curl -fsSL https://macos.builditwithai.xyz/install | bash`
- Documentation: https://macos.builditwithai.xyz

## Primary Tools
- `notify(title, message, sound)`: Dispatches native macOS desktop notifications.
- `clipboard_read()`: Reads clipboard text.
- `clipboard_write(text)`: Writes clipboard text.
- `get_audio_devices()`: Lists audio devices and volume.
- `set_volume(volume)`: Sets output volume (0-100).
- `get_frontmost_app()`: Returns active focused app.
- `get_open_windows()`: Lists window titles.
- `get_displays()`: Lists connected monitors.
- `open_url(url)`: Opens URL in browser.
- `execute_applescript(script)`: Runs AppleScript safely.

## Environment Variables
- `DO_NOT_TRACK`: Set to `1` to disable anonymous telemetry.
